description: Adversarial cases for the PII / fact-fabrication validator. Each case has a stakeholder fact set + a candidate response. expected.ok=false means the validator MUST flag fabricated content. Cases include an artifact because the v1 validator only runs when an artifact is present (shouldValidate gate) — coaching-only responses skip the judge.
